section.p: Born from the creativity and innovation of genuine Aussies, Liaise International proudly presents the iconic Rocko's line alongside other brands that have become part of Australian culture.
We began with a simple vision: create durable, authentic products that suit the Australian lifestyle, from demanding workdays to relaxed afternoons at the beach.
Rocko's products are designed for resilience, reliability and everyday comfort. Our legendary Double Pluggers, sunnies, hats, caps and accessories are made to handle the Australian outdoors.
Liaise International also represents brands including Mangrove Jacks and Smartcell, offering outdoor, fishing and technology products for customers across Australia.
Interested in stocking Rocko's in your store? Submit an Expression of Interest and our team will contact you.
We are committed to quality, sustainable practices and supporting the local communities that support us.

We offer returns within 30 days of purchase. Products may be returned for a credit, exchange or refund to the original payment method. Customers are responsible for return shipping unless the item is faulty or damaged.
Before returning an item, contact Customer Care to obtain a Return Authorisation number.

ul.li: Returns must be requested within 30 days of purchase.
Items must be unused, with original swing tags and packaging intact.
Items showing signs of wear or use may be returned to the customer without refund or credit.

section.p: Email support@rockos.com.au with your order number and photographs of the item's condition. Approved faulty or damaged returns will have return shipping covered.
Approved refunds, exchanges and store credits are normally processed within two business days after inspection. Original shipping fees are non-refundable.
We deliver within Australia. Orders are processed within one to three business days after payment and an order confirmation. Tracking details are emailed after dispatch.

ul.li: Retail orders over $50 qualify for free shipping.
Retail orders under $50 are charged a flat rate of $12.50.
Most orders are shipped via Australia Post Standard Delivery.
Orders received before 10am Monday to Friday are typically dispatched the same day.
Orders received after 10am, on weekends or public holidays are dispatched the next business day.

section.p: Standard delivery is generally one to five business days. Rural deliveries may take longer. We do not dispatch on weekends or public holidays.
Please allow up to 48 hours for tracking to become available. We ship to P.O. Boxes and Parcel Lockers within Australia.
If your order has not arrived within 14 business days of its shipping confirmation, contact support@rockos.com.au with your name and order number.
Liaise International respects your privacy and handles personal information in accordance with applicable Australian privacy laws.
We may collect information you provide when placing an order, creating an account, contacting us, subscribing to communications or submitting a form.

ul.li: To process orders, payments, deliveries, returns and customer support.
To operate and improve our website and services.
To send marketing communications where consent has been provided.

section.p: Information may be shared with trusted service providers where required to fulfil orders and operate our business. We take reasonable steps to protect personal information from misuse, loss and unauthorised access.
To request access, correction or deletion of your personal information, contact support@rockos.com.au.
Rockos and Liaise International take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect customer information and online transactions.
Payments are processed through approved payment providers. Rockos does not intentionally store complete payment card details.
Keep your password confidential and contact us immediately if you suspect unauthorised account activity.
Please report suspected security issues to support@rockos.com.au with enough detail for our team to investigate.

Thank you for your interest in Liaise International. We welcome enquiries from potential stockists, partners, customers and collaborators who share our passion for durable, high-quality Australian products.
Please provide as much detail as possible about your store, organisation and requirements. Our team will review your information and contact you to discuss the next steps.

div.p: Include your full name, store name, contact phone number, email address and any questions.

section.p: Measurements are in centimetres and are provided as a guide.

section.h2: Liaise International Proudly Supports the AMRF
section.p: Liaise International and Rockos are proud to support the Australian Melanoma Research Foundation, helping raise awareness and essential funds for melanoma research.
A percentage of sales from selected AMRF-endorsed Rockos, Mangrove Jacks, MJ Kids and Stiletto polarised sunglasses is directed to the foundation.

Support the cause by purchasing AMRF-endorsed sunglasses from participating stockists, including selected IGA stores, fishing and boating stores, newsagents, service stations, general stores, roadhouses and pharmacies.
section.h2: Together, We Can Make a Difference
section.p: By choosing AMRF-endorsed sunglasses, you are protecting your eyes with quality eyewear while contributing to vital melanoma research.
